exact_statement: For a finite constrained-deadline C-AMC-sem task set scheduled by single-processor fully-preemptive work-conserving strict fixed-priority scheduling under the stated mode, release, execution-version and recovery semantics, if every task i has complete LO/Case1/Case2 WCRT witnesses satisfying R_i(LO) <= D_i and R_i(HI) <= D_i, then the entire reference task set is schedulable.
